name: Richard Blumenthal

issue_poll.name: Quinnipiac University Connecticut Poll, Sept 15–19, 2022 (likely voters)
issue_poll.note: Most urgent issue question gave ranks 1–9; COVID-19 (0%) and 'something else' dropped. Rank 10 (gun control, 2%) taken from the WNE Polling Institute CT poll, Sept 15–21, 2022: https://www1.wne.edu/news/2022/10/z-ct-Issues-TABLES.pdf

issues.position: More LIHEAP heating aid; release Strategic Petroleum Reserve oil
issues.note: Reserve releases are executive actions; no floor vote isolated LIHEAP funding levels.

issues.position: Restore the expanded child tax credit

votes.bill_title: Tax Relief for American Families and Workers Act
votes.question: Cloture on the motion to proceed

issues.note: H.R.1 (2025) raised the credit to $2,200 but did not restore the 2021 expansion; not counted.

issues.position: Do more to fight climate change; build clean-energy future
Oppose defunding police; more resources for police shortages
Pass federal law codifying abortion rights

votes.question: Cloture on the motion to proceed

issues.position: Extend $2,000 drug cost cap beyond seniors; no Medicare/Social Security cuts
issues.note: No floor vote on extending the cap or on cutting Medicare/Social Security benefits.

issues.position: Cited the 2021 infrastructure law; no forward position found
Protect voting rights (general); no specific campaign-year position found
Assault weapons and ghost gun ban, wider background checks, safe storage
issues.note: None of these measures got a Senate floor vote this term.

caveats: Rank 10 comes from a second CT poll because the Quinnipiac list ran out of testable items.
Gun position is from a May 2022 Senate floor speech; his fall campaign said only 'build on' the 2022 gun law.
Several issues not testable because campaign coverage focused on his record, not new proposals.
